scope: Four complete supplied essays in eight languages, with local editorial and scientific corrections. Original source folder and ZIPs unchanged.

review.method: Read the four Simplified Chinese arguments and perform targeted cross-language checks of correction sites, examples and conclusions. This is not a claim of exhaustive independent verification of every scientific assertion.
review.originals: All 32 imported texts match the supplied Markdown / ZIP members and stored SHA-256.
corrections: EP09: Pakicetus discovery versus description; Flinders Ranges nomination versus inscription; a preservational collection need not be monophyletic, rather than having no common ancestor.

EP10: qualify GSSP scope; Marble Canyon discovery/reporting dates; Qingjiang 53% of taxa, not specimens; distinct preservation pathways can share biases; align stromatolite cross-reference with reviewed EP07.

EP11: no complete megalodon skeleton, not no cartilage; feather wording and Wollemi fire season; conditional chain rule, limits of sampling reconstruction and sparse data; explicit constant-rate assumptions; missed-detection likelihood versus posterior probability; independent evidence construction versus shared evolutionary history; unknown denominator versus nonexistent denominator.

EP12: conditional tetrapod-track interpretation; traits need not all change together; gill ventilation; regulatory co-option is redeployment, not bodily DNA movement; module reuse does not exclude local changes; active insect ventilation and multiple size constraints; do not infer missing lignin degraders from coal accumulation.
All four essays: preserve episode-specific conclusions and remove the identical stock refrain.
review.references: Selected primary research and author-institution sources are linked beneath each article; see references.json.
review.completeness: All eight sections and original paragraph counts retained per essay. Minimum reviewed/original character ratio across the 32 editions exceeds 0.999; length is a supporting check, not a substitute for editorial review.

verification.structural: scripts/test_paleontology.py: 4 tests passed; full text, immutable source hashes, reproducibility, links, anchors, taxonomy, canonical/hreflang, search, sitemap and published group boundaries.
verification.browser: 312 page/viewport cases at 375/768/1440 px; eight-language menus, TOC, heading visibility, no horizontal overflow; Library/Latest language-aware destinations; no-JS English-to-Japanese navigation; zero page errors.
verification.regression: EP01–07 byte-identical to pre-batch HEAD; EP08 changes only next-essay navigation. All unrelated search records unchanged.
verification.preview: Desktop grouped hub and Traditional Chinese EP12 mobile screenshot visually inspected; no overlap.
verification.discovery: 32 added search source records and 32 new sitemap URLs. Total 104 series HTML pages; 13 per language.
